_comment: design-lint.py prefix allowlist (symbol check). Every entry must carry a
reason. These are tokens that MATCH the stable-ID regex but are not design
namespaces — encodings, standards, model names, and the audit-sweep
severity row numbering (HIGH-1/MED-3/LOW-2). Removing an entry makes its
occurrences findings again. A doc-scoped alternative is the inline pragma:

prefixes.UTF: UTF-8 — encoding token, not a namespace
prefixes.GPT: GPT-4 / GPT-5 — LLM model names quoted in prose
prefixes.HIGH: audit-sweep severity row numbering (HIGH-n), local to the sweep banners, not a stable namespace
prefixes.PRR: platform PR-review item numbering (PRR-20, PRR-23) — cross-repo process items, not a design-track namespace (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.FG: frontend-game V0 milestone/acceptance numbering (FG-1..16, AC-FG-n) — declaring spec docs/specs/2026-05-24-frontend-game-architecture.md lives outside this corpus (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.WARN: AMAW adversary-review warning numbering (WARN-n) in SESSION_HANDOFF retros — process-local, not a namespace (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.LW: LW-1234 — example admin/support ticket id in 02_storage prose, not a namespace (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.DEFER: DEFER-V2 / DEFER-V2+ resolution-status tags in closure tables — statuses, not IDs (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.CON: sub-segment of compound PL_005 deferral ids (INT-CON-D1..D10) — parent namespace INT is catalogued (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.GIV: sub-segment of compound PL_005b acceptance ids (AC-INT-GIV-n) — parent namespace INT is catalogued (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.USE: sub-segment of compound PL_005b acceptance ids (AC-INT-USE-n) — parent namespace INT is catalogued (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.STK: sub-segment of compound PL_005b acceptance ids (AC-INT-STK-n) — parent namespace INT is catalogued (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.SPK: sub-segment of compound PL_005b acceptance ids (AC-INT-SPK-n) — parent namespace INT is catalogued (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.EXM: sub-segment of compound PL_005b acceptance ids (AC-INT-EXM-n) — parent namespace INT is catalogued (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.INV: sub-segment of compound PL_007b acceptance ids (AC-INV-1..11) — parent namespace ITM is catalogued (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.RMBG: RMBG-1.4 — BriaAI background-removal model name quoted in TMP_009, not a namespace (backfill 2026-07-27)
prefixes.EWD: EWD-123 — Dijkstra manuscript citation in TMP prose, not a namespace (backfill 2026-07-27)
